verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that developers push data from their primary database into Typesense and can add documents to a collection and then search them. Nothing documents update or delete operations, how quickly changes become visible, or that no full reindex is needed. missing for 10: documented single-document update/upsert and delete APIs, explicit near-real-time visibility guarantees, confirmation that changes apply incrementally without a full reindex, independent or hands-on corroboration.
